observations.observation: The continuation mechanism remains perceptible as a larger geometric enclosure around the authored region; the box has been expanded rather than perceptually dissolved.
Outer terrain, water, horizon and atmosphere do not yet form one continuous depth system. Tonal, elevation and frequency changes disclose the layer boundary.

The region reads predominantly arid or desert-like because exposed tan/brown material dominates while vegetation, moisture and humid atmospheric cues are insufficient for the intended subtropical coastal identity.
Vegetation and surface material are not yet visibly governed strongly enough by drainage, freshwater proximity, shelter, slope, elevation, exposure and coastal influence.

The coast is geographically clearer after removing opposing land, but it remains biologically and materially sparse; beach, wet/dry transition, coastal vegetation and nearshore atmospheric relationships do not yet sell a warm living coast.

Gratitude remains too round and blob-like at macro scale. Local geometry is becoming more credible, but the overall disposition lacks enough directional asymmetry, headlands, bays, drainage orientation and relief logic to become a trustworthy continental positional standard.
Environmental work performed now can become regression debt if biome, hydrology or continuation logic is bound to the provisional silhouette.

The experience has a distinctive spatial premise and meaningful direct traversal, but visible procedural boundaries, repetitive low-frequency terrain treatment, weak biome specificity and exposed continuation mechanics prevent the technology from becoming perceptually invisible.

H-Earth is detailed enough to expose defects in the planetary representation, but not yet believable enough to become the source standard. Gratitude must first achieve credible local geography and environmental identity before its proven positional relationships can drive Audralia morphology reconciliation.
Current visual inspection evidence is insufficient to declare reference-class cross-device functionality, accessibility or performance complete.

For an immersive spatial surface, environmental content is the place itself. The current desert-like and procedurally bounded read communicates the wrong story about Gratitude before explicit narrative can correct it.
The reciprocal globe-region model, noninteractive visible-world continuation and region-to-continent calibration concept are materially distinctive, but their reusable value is not yet proven.
